```{r}
analyze_and_fill_missing_values <- function(
  df, 
  drop_threshold = 1, 
  report_path = NULL, 
  validate = TRUE 
) {
  
  # 1. Compute missing counts (Single scan - mimics polars schema check)
  n_rows <- nrow(df)
  missing_counts_df <- tibble(
    column = colnames(df),
    dtype = sapply(df, function(x) mode(x)), # 'integer', 'numeric', 'character' approx Polars dtypes
    n_missing = sapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x))) # Check for NA (covers NaN/Inf logic in R mostly)
  )
  
  # R Specific: Check for numeric inf/nan specifically
  float_columns <- which(!is.logical(missing_counts_df$column)) # Not a perfect check but approximates Polars numeric check
  
  # Better missing calculation including Float specific checks (Inf/Nan)
  compute_missing_with_types <- function(col, df_col) {
    v <- df_col[[1]]
    is_na_v <- sum(is.na(v))
    
    if (is.numeric(v)) {
      is_nan_inf_v <- sum(!is.finite(v & !is.na(v))) # Check for Inf or NaN
      return(is_na_v + is_nan_inf_v)
    }
    return(is_na_v)
  }
  
  # Re-calculate missing counts properly
  missing_vals_df <- tibble(
    column = names(df),
    n_missing = sapply(df, function(x) compute_missing_with_types(names(df)[1], x)) 
  )
  
  # Sort for reporting
  report_summary <- missing_vals_df %>% 
    arrange(desc(n_missing)) 
  
  # Write Report to CSV if provided
  if (!is.null(report_path)) {
    dir.create(dirname(report_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(report_summary, file.path(report_path), row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  # Filter out columns with more than threshold missing values
  cols_to_drop <- report_summary$column[report_summary$n_missing > drop_threshold]
  
  if (length(cols_to_drop) > 0) {
    df <- df %>% select(-all_of(cols_to_drop))
    message(paste("Dropped columns with > drop_threshold missing:", length(cols_to_drop)))
  }
  
  # 2. Fill Missing Values (Mimics fill logic based on dtype)
  df_filled <- df
  
  # Float/Double Logic
  for (col in names(df)) {
    if (!is.logical(df[[col]])) { 
      if (!is.numeric(df[[col]])) next 
      # Check if we want to handle numeric as "Float" logic (fill Inf/Nan with 0)
      # Only apply this if mode is 'double' not 'integer' ideally, but R doesn't distinguish strongly in vectors
    }
    
    # Apply fill based on type detection using sapply
    df_filled <- df_filled %>% 
      mutate(
        across(all_of(names(df)), ~ {
          v <- .x
          if (is.numeric(v)) {
            # Handle Inf/Nan/NA -> 0
            ifelse(is.infinite(v) | is.nan(v), 0, .x)
          } else if (is.logical(v)) {
            # Handle NA -> FALSE
            as.integer(!!!ifelse(is.na(.x), TRUE, !!.x == TRUE)) # Convert back to logical
            # Simple way: replace_na(FALSE) works for boolean logic
          } else if (is.character(v)) {
            # Handle NA -> "N/A"
            .x[!is.na(.x)]
          } else {
            return(.x)
          }
        })
      )
  }
  
  # R Tidyverse Implementation for Filling using `across` is cleaner:
  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(everything(), ~{
        x <- .x
        if (is.numeric(x)) {
          return(ifelse(is.infinite(x) | is.nan(x) | is.na(x), 0, x))
        } else if (is.logical(x)) {
          return(ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, x))
        } else if (is.character(x)) {
          return(ifelse(is.na(x), "N/A", x))
        } else {
          return(.x) # Unhandled dtype
        }
      })
    )
    
  # 3. Validation Logic (Mimics validate step)
  if (validate) {
    remaining_missing <- sum(!is.na(df[[1]])) == 0 # Check for first column just as example
    
    # Re-check full columns for completeness
    validation_report <- tibble(
      col = names(df),
      remaining_na = sapply(df, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
    ) %>% 
      filter(remaining_na != 0) # Check which still have NA after fill
    
    if (nrow(validation_report) > 0) {
      message("WARNING: Columns still contain missing values after filling:")
      for (i in 1:nrow(validation_report)) {
        msg <- paste("  - ", validation_report$col[i], ": ", 
                     validation_report$remaining_na[i])
        cat(msg)
      }
    } else {
      message("Validation Passed: No missing values remaining.")
    }
    
    # Stop if any remain (assert equivalent)
    if (nrow(validation_report) > 0) {
      stop("Assertion failed: Unfilled columns detected") 
    }
  }
  
  return(list(df = df, report_summary = report_summary))
}
```

```{r}
drop_columns <- function(df, cols_to_drop) {
  # -all_of safely checks if column names exist in the dataframe before dropping
  select(df, -all_of(cols_to_drop))
}
```
